in_sanskrit.name: तेज्पल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses or protects the radiance or power of Tejas (tejas).

in_hindi.name: तेजपाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: वासिक तेजस्वी (vāsik tejāsvi) - One who possesses or protects the radiance or power of Tejas (tejas).

in_tamil.name: தேஜ்பால்

in_marathi.name: Tejpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining, Bright
